ValidationRule.description: Annual Spend may drop by at most 50% in one edit, tier downgrades need a Type of 'Customer - Direct' or blank, and territory changes lock Global accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND(ISCHANGED(Annual_Spend__c), NULLVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Annual_Spend__c), 0) > 0, Annual_Spend__c < 0.5 * PRIORVALUE(Annual_Spend__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Account_Tier__c), CASE(TEXT(Account_Tier__c), 'Bronze', 0, 'Silver', 1, 'Gold', 2, 'Platinum', 3, -1) < CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Account_Tier__c)), 'Bronze', 0, 'Silver', 1, 'Gold', 2, 'Platinum', 3, -1), NOT(OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Type)), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Customer - Direct')))), AND(ISCHANGED(Sales_Territories__c), INCLUDES(PRIORVALUE(Sales_Territories__c), 'Global')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Spend, tier or territory change not allowed.
